title: battery.culprit payload v1
description: Tier 3 is red on tip sha; the batch bisection over the tips advanced since the last green tip (good_sha) names the first red tip (culprit_sha) and its batch and PRs, or, when battery.bisection_max_runs ran out first, the batches still in doubt (candidates). The lane fixes or reverts; the battery never does.

good_sha.description: The last tip tier 3 found green; null when no green tip precedes the window.

culprit_sha.description: The first red tip of the window; null when the bisection ran out of runs first.

batch_id.description: The train batch whose advance produced culprit_sha; null when unresolved.

candidates.description: Batch ids still in doubt, oldest first; exactly [batch_id] when resolved.
